title: OSU vs PennState: tuition, size, location
summary: Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (OSU) versus Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (PennState). Also searched as PennState vs OSU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona and Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (PennState vs OSU) are both public institutions but differ significantly in size and location. PennState vs OSU has an undergraduate enrollment of 2,367 students, whereas OSU has a smaller undergraduate population of 464. The two schools are situated in different cities, with PennState located in Altoona and OSU in Wooster. Additionally, tuition costs vary between the two, with PennState charging $15,972 for in-state students compared to OSU's $9,584.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona and Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (PennState vs OSU), there are notable differences in cost. PennState vs OSU charges $15,972 for in-state tuition, while OSU's in-state tuition is lower at $9,584. Out-of-state tuition at PennState vs OSU is $26,958, which is less than OSU's $36,362. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at PennState vs OSU is $25,000, whereas OSU's median debt is $19,976. These figures highlight the varying financial commitments required for attending each institution.
